tools.name: memory.save
tools.desc: Save or update a durable fact.

tools.name: memory.search
tools.desc: Search deep memory by tag. this will NOT find id's or info on notes or other information about features. memory is strictly facts you learned about the world.

tools.name: room.add_note
tools.desc: Add a sticky note to the room.

tools.name: room.delete_note
tools.desc: Delete a sticky note by id. You MUST find a notes id with room.list_notes tool call first

tools.name: room.list_notes
tools.desc: List notes/stickies currently in the room. Used to get the information about all the notes; including id, text, and location.
